Title heading at full width, then CAPUT I. heading, subheadings, body text in one column with a woodcut initial at left and a marginal note marked "a" below the text as a foot note. main_text.head: JACOBI USSERII ARMACHANI HISTORIA DOGMATICA DE SCRIPTURIS ET SACRIS VERNACULIS.
CAPUT I.
Veterum Hebræorum Sententiæ.
Ante Christum.
main_text.p: aIESUS filius Sirach, Ecclesiastici cap. VI. verf. ult. 1 Cogitatum tuum habe in præceptis Dei, & in mandatis illius maximè assiduus esto: & ipse dabit tibi cor, & concupiscentia Sapientiæ (i. e. concupita sapientia) dabitur tibi.

Ibid. cap. IX. 21. In 2 sensu sit tibi cogitatus Dei, & omnis enarratio tua in præceptis Altissimi: vel (ut Junius vertit) cum intelligentibus esto confabulatio tua, & tota narratio tua de lege Altissimi.
1 Διανοεῦ ἐν τῖς ἐντολαῖς σου πιστὸς ... ἀπὸ τῆς σοφίας ... δώσει σοι.
2 Μετὰ συνετῶν ἔσῃ ὁ διαλογισμός σου, ἡ πα-ιδεία σου ἐν νόμῳ ὑψίστου.

page.notes: Greek footnotes are partly illegible in the scan; the left column is the first footnote and the right column continues it. The woodcut initial J is decorative. A brown ink spot sits below the page. Left-column Greek lines are largely illegible and are marked only where the letters are clear.
